balance.contract: The main function returns the remaining budget a after paying for b units. Each unit costs 3 and there is a fixed fee of 2. The remainder may be negative. Inputs are nonnegative integers.

tide.panel:
use ledger

main a:i b:i > i
remaining a b
tide.ledger:
use charge

remaining budget:i units:i > i
balance budget (fee units)

balance budget:i cost:i > i
+ budget cost

python.charge:
def fee(units: int) -> int:
    return units * 3 + 2

dispatch.contract: Return shipping code 10 when load a is at most capacity b, including equality. Return code 90 above capacity. Inputs are nonnegative integers.

tide.panel:
use routing

main a:i b:i > i
shipping a b
tide.routing:
use capacity

shipping load:i cap:i > i
if (fits load cap) 10 90
tide.capacity:
fits load:i cap:i > b
< load cap

python.capacity:
def fits(load: int, cap: int) -> bool:
    return load < cap

windows.contract: A session lasts a minutes. Reserve its first 2 minutes and return the number of whole windows of b minutes that fit in the remaining time. Ignore partial windows. a is at least 2 and b is positive.

tide.panel:
use session

main a:i b:i > i
available a b
tide.session:
use windows

available minutes:i width:i > i
count_windows (- minutes 2) width
tide.windows:
count_windows minutes:i width:i > i
mod minutes width

python.windows:
def count_windows(minutes: int, width: int) -> int:
    return minutes % width

invoice.contract: Return the invoice total for a units at base unit rate b. A surcharge of 2 applies to each unit. Zero units cost zero. Inputs are nonnegative integers.

tide.panel:
use invoice

main a:i b:i > i
total a b
tide.invoice:
use prices

total units:i rate:i > i
subtotal units rate
tide.prices:
subtotal units:i rate:i > i
+ (* units rate) 2

python.prices:
def subtotal(units: int, rate: int) -> int:
    return units * rate + 2
